 Ariana Grande debuts most dramatic hair transformation yet: how to style her striking new retro bob 
 The singer's jaw-grazing new hairstyle is the picture of elegance
 By Aisha Nozari Published: 23 October 2026 Save Article Ariana Grande has debuted a dramatic new hair transformation just in time for winter, ditching her trademark ponytail for a sleek flicked bob. 
 Taking inspiration from the Sixties and so-called because of the way hair ends flick away from the jawline, flicked (or flipped) bobs have surged in popularity in recent months, with a plethora of stylish women seen sporting the hairstyle at this season’s fashion weeks .
 Ever the trendsetter, it’s no wonder Grande has taken the style for a spin herself, debuting her new, retro-inspired cut this week on Instagram. The singer’s new bob is the work of hairstylist Brandon Pietsch, who shared photos of Grande’s striking transformation on social media, quipping: “The ponytail is taking a hiatus, cut and colour by me.” Clearly thrilled with her new 'do, Grande wrote “ily” beneath Pietsch’s post.
 View full post on Instagram Grazing her jaw and flicking out dramatically at the ends, Grande’s hair had also been styled into a deep side parting and was noticeably darker, with the singer’s mid chocolatey tone replaced by a rich, espresso brown. 
 Speaking previously to Bazaar about the flicked bob’s popularity, Larry King, one of London’s leading hair stylists, explained: “It takes inspiration from the Sixties, but with a more modern, smoothed-down finish and just a little lift at the crown.”
 Victor Virgile // Getty Images King also said that the hair flip is perfect for anyone in the bob or mid-length camp and that the style is more low-maintenance than it looks. “It works well with anything jaw- to shoulder-length and doesn’t take on the huge commitment of a different cut; it's just a simple styling trick that can change things up to look really new.”
 What to Read Next
 King also kindly told us how to achieve the look at home, sharing: “Apply a mousse [like King’s My Nanna’s Mousse] to wet hair,” to ensure soft, bouncy volume, and smooth out the hair while blow-drying with a round brush.
 Low-maintenance, elegant and surprisingly versatile, it’s no wonder Grande braved the chop; we’re considering following suit.
